reason: We do library storytime, parks and church groups, and I almost never pay for kid stuff. I'd take the free first visit maybe, but $15 a visit is hard to justify when I'm chasing my kid anyway and won't get to sit with the coffee.
objection: $15 a visit for something I can get free at the library or a park, and I'll be up chasing my toddler instead of sitting and drinking coffee.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price around $6 to $8 per child, or something that lets my kid play on their own while I actually sit.
